targetText: A man who buys the favours of a woman does not see her as a comrade or as a person with equal rights. He sees the woman as dependent upon himself and as an unequal creature of a lower order.
explanation: How commercialized sex undermines working-class solidarity: buying women fosters male chauvinism and breaks the mutual respect required between equal comrades.

targetText: Under communism, all dependence of women upon men and all elements of material calculation found in modern marriage will be absent.
explanation: The ultimate goal of Marxist feminism: total economic independence for women, eliminating financial bargaining so that personal unions are built entirely on free choice, mutual passion, and equal comradeship.

targetText: Healthy, joyful, and free relationships between the sexes will develop. A new generation will come into being, independent and courageous, placing the good of the collective above all else.
explanation: The communist transformation of human intimacy: replacing commercial calculation and female dependence with free, mutual unions of equal working comrades.
